entries.candidate: Google West Memphis campus second phase (expansion announced by Entergy Arkansas, 19 October 2026)
entries.reason: Entergy Arkansas's 19 October 2026 release (us-la-ms-al-ar-p4-entergy-arkansas-google-west-memphis-20261019) announces a second phase of service that 'will fulfill Google's plan for data center buildings on the site' and serve 'the expanded data center campus'. A separate expansion project cannot be added: the existing site's locator is an imported approximate-site point (geometry_use_scope approximate_site_locator), and an addition to an existing site must reuse a campus_locator. The release and Google's post of the same day state no physical status for the campus, so no status refresh is made either; the grid plans are attached as power-readiness context in this fragment.
entries.reopen_condition: A reviewed campus locator for the West Memphis site (official Crittenden County parcel or a regulator-filed facility coordinate) through a geometry review, after which a dated Google or Entergy record of the expansion buildings can be added as a project; or a dated primary statement of construction or operation for a status refresh.

entries.candidate: STACK / Amazon Caddo Parish campus, State Line Road north of Blanchard-Latex Road, near Blanchard, Caddo Parish, Louisiana (first northwest Louisiana campus outside Bossier Parish)
entries.reason: Not in the Atlas (the Atlas holds the Bossier Highway 3 Technology Park campus and the third, Resilient Technology Park campus in Shreveport). STACK's 10 June 2026 release says construction was 'already underway at its planned campuses in Caddo and Bossier Parishes', but that is outside the 85-day window. In-window sources only describe the programme: Amazon's page updated 18 August 2026 (three planned campuses across Caddo and Bossier Parishes, the third in Shreveport), Louisiana Economic Development's 27 August release, and Bossier Parish's 20 August meeting notes ('Amazon's proposed data center developments in Bossier and Caddo Parishes'); none names or locates the State Line Road campus. Caddo Parish Commission minutes of 3 September to 19 October 2026 discuss data centres generally (public comment and a proposed natural-gas plant near LA-169) without naming the campus. No official locator is reachable: Caddo parcel layers are published only through NLCOG utility.arcgis.com proxies (not used), the Caddo assessor search is a third-party form, LDEQ and the USACE Vicksburg District return HTTP 403 to robots.txt, and the Internet Archive holds no recent copy of the USACE notice index. The September 2026 round-39 research packet (sources/research-expansion-200-americas-round39-caddo-2026-09-10.json) reached the same gap.
entries.reopen_condition: A dated in-window STACK, Amazon, Caddo Parish or state record that names the State Line Road (Blanchard) campus, plus an official parcel, permit or regulator-filed coordinate tying SAC III Acquisition Co. LLC (or another named STACK entity) to the land.
